title: Google published an update on Gemini Intelligence for Android
summary: On 2026-05-15, Google published an official Android-platform update concerning Gemini Intelligence for Android. From the dated official link alone, this is a public development milestone for the project; the available evidence does not establish its specific capabilities, rollout scope, or availability.
